## Fix applied — SelectDateWidget OverflowError (django/forms/widgets.py:1160)

**Cause:** `SelectDateWidget.value_from_datadict()` builds a date from user-controlled `y/m/d` GET/POST values with `datetime.date(int(y), int(m), int(d))`, guarding only `ValueError`. A year larger than a C long (e.g. `1234567821345678`) raises `OverflowError`, which escapes and crashes t
